redirect_uri.description:
Must equal the `redirect_uri` the code was issued for,
by exact string comparison.

code_verifier.description:
The PKCE verifier. Required for `authorization_code` for
every client type, including confidential ones.

scope.description:
On a refresh this may narrow the granted scope and may
never widen it — widening would make the refresh token
more powerful than the consent that created it.

client_secret.description:
`client_secret_post`. Use the Authorization header
instead where you can; presenting both is refused.
